scope: Scaffolding and unit tests only; no model experiments launched

arms.A0: Unchanged selected projected parent; default if no candidate passes
arms.A1: Parent expanded to rank64; verified SFT with replay
arms.A2: Same initialization, examples, order and updates as A1; add replay-only forward KL
arms.S1: Stock with fresh zero-output rank64 adapter; same SFT schedule
arms.S2: Same stock initialization as S1; add replay-only forward KL

training.optimizer: Fresh AdamW for every trained arm; no transplanted parent moments
training.teacher: Pinned uncompressed source; no test/dev outputs used
training.kl_positions: Answer tokens, including EOS, on explicitly tagged verified replay rows only
training.loss_normalization: Sum CE over all answer tokens plus lambda times sum KL over replay tokens, divided by all answer tokens in the optimizer update
training.teacher_cache: Absolute top-k log probabilities plus an omitted-mass bucket; token chunks
training.teacher_cache_identity: Ordered row ID + SHA256 of the complete encoded sequence + prediction position; reject missing or reordered identities
training.cache_caveat: Coarsened KL is a lower bound, not exact full KL; measure sampled full-KL gap and retained mass before fixing k

evaluation_requirements: Fresh development/test groups disjoint from training, replay and calibration; group manifests and overlap audit
Historical inspected tests used only for regression diagnostics
Paired per-family gained/lost counts, denominators and task-group uncertainty
Frozen practical primary-gain threshold and retention noninferiority margin
Separate per-family code and science no-net-loss gates; rubric grades required before selection
No new loop cases, even if old loops improve; at most one previously completed answer lost
Every selection candidate receives code edge/property tests and long-form generation checks
Stratified train/held-out CE and generation diagnostics; no inference from one training row per kind
Parent/expanded logit tolerance, cached/full-forward checks, fixed baseline generations and saved-adapter reload
Fixed precision, decoding, batch composition, token limits and thread count per protocol
Test evaluated once after development selection; no test-driven hyperparameter changes
limitations: S1/S2 check the training recipe on stock; their adaptation history differs from the continued projected parent, so an interaction does not isolate projection causally
Equal answer tokens and updates do not imply equal compute; report teacher-cache and geometry construction costs separately
T=1 and lambda=1 are predeclared pilot choices, not tuned optima
No dataset has been created, no protocol frozen, and no model improvement established by these helpers

resources.local_runs: Dibs lease and peer-reviewed frozen protocol required; multi-hour runs excluded from this turn
